item.title: 6 months after quake, 25,000 children still live, study in tents in Kunar
item.description: Save the Children says around 25,000 children are still living and studying in tents six months after a deadly earthquake struck eastern Kunar province.

item.title: Women in Nimroz reject plastic, promote cloth bags, kitchen gardens
item.description: As plastic pollution grows into a serious environmental and health challenge in Afghanistan, women in northwestern Nimroz province are rejecting plastic bags in favour of cloth ones and establishing kitchen gardens, actively promoting a cleaner, safer and healthier living environment.

item.title: Public school teachers in Kabul demand pay rise
item.description: Several public school teachers in the capital, Kabul, have said their current salaries are insufficient, calling for an increase.

item.title: Afghan Karate team heads to Russia for international event
item.description: The Afghanistan Karate Federation (AKF) announced that three national athletes in the Kyokushin-kan style have departed for Russia to compete in an international tournament.
